overview:
**Fire danger is Low across the Montrose (High Elevation) area today, with low fuel dryness (ERC 42%, BI 41%) keeping conditions calm.**
- Danger stays Low all week, with ERC/BI percentiles holding in the 38–45% range through Nov 12.
- Light winds (4–6 mph, shifting N/NNE) and cooler temps (41–48°F) are the main weather drivers this week.
- 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are met today, and no Red Flag Warnings are active or forecast.
Gunnison and Ouray counties have rescinded fire restrictions, with only standard year-round rules in effect. No Stage 1 or Stage 2 restrictions are currently posted for Montrose-area BLM or county lands.
- No active wildfires or new starts are reported in or near these 13 counties in the latest national situation report.
